Create Custom Contour Plot for SSE

Source: R/plotting.R
sse_contour_plot.Rd

Generate a contour plot of the sum of squared errors as a function of two parameters, with the remaining parameters fixed.

Usage

sse_contour_plot(
  log_p,
  t,
  par,
  vars,
  lower = c(0, -0.001),
  upper = c(1, 0.001),
  cp = TRUE,
  sp = FALSE,
  fb = FALSE,
  point = c(NA, NA),
  mode = 0
)

Arguments

log_p

Numeric vector of log-prices.

t

Numeric vector of time indices.

par

Named list of fixed parameter values.

vars

Named list specifying x and y variables as character strings.

lower

Numeric vector of length 2, lower bounds for x and y axes.

upper

Numeric vector of length 2, upper bounds for x and y axes.

cp

Logical, whether to generate contour plot (default TRUE).

sp

Logical, whether to generate surface plot (default FALSE).

fb

Logical, whether to print feedback (default FALSE).

point

Numeric vector of length 2, optional point to highlight.

mode

Integer, LPPLS model mode (default 0).

Value

A list with three elements:

contour_plot

A ggplot2 contour plot, or NULL when cp = FALSE.

surface_plot

A plotly 3-D surface, or NULL when sp = FALSE.

contour_data

The SSE grid itself, always returned: a list with the grid values x and y of the two parameters and the matrix z of SSE values, with z[j, i] the SSE at (x[i], y[j]).

Examples

## A simulated bubble whose critical time is t = 221
set.seed(4)
t     <- 1:200
log_p <- eval_lppls(t, A = 8, B = -0.025, C1 = 0.0015, C2 = 0.001,
                    tc = 221, m = 0.6, omega = 8) + rnorm(200, sd = 0.01)

## The SSE over (m, omega), with the other parameters held at their true
## values
fixed  <- list(tc = 221, A = 8, B = -0.025, C1 = 0.0015, C2 = 0.001)
result <- sse_contour_plot(log_p, t, fixed, vars = list(x = "m", y = "omega"),
                           lower = c(0.1, 6), upper = c(0.9, 13))
result$contour_plot


dim(result$contour_data$z)   # the grid itself
#> [1] 101 101
